Items.title: Products
Items.body:
The item master: everything you sell or buy, with categories, variants, tax code and prices.

In the catalog you create and edit items, filtered by category on the left; variants sit indented under their parent. The second tab holds the price lists.

Archiving is a soft flag: the item stays, history included. A hard delete only succeeds for an item nothing references any more.
